preservation: All348 registered assets remain unchanged. All156 controlled comparisons have one authored home and full-size/narrow access. Source articles and metadata are archived byte-for-byte as text.

comparison_suites.scope: Original geometry, copy, source-byte, crop, tone and scale checks retained; discovery contracts follow editorial ownership rather than requiring three inline images per source article.

consolidation_tests.scope: Core inventory, collections, metadata, search aliases, legacy queries and routes, actual anchors, draft isolation, original348 asset hashes,52 archived article hashes,36 current body hashes,156 comparison homes and three developed figures in each merged article.

validation.markdown_renderer: 13 tests passed in the regression run.
validation.graphic_marks: All36 active Graphic Design marks match the active pattern set and summaries; bounded geometry and portable rendering regression checks passed.
validation.content: Final validation passed for896 entities with drafts included in the observed shared workspace snapshot.

browser.result: No horizontal page overflow; correct responsive source selection for merged-article figures; legacy query strings and section fragments preserved; consolidated index checked.
browser.method: First20 articles at both widths completed before a development-navigation interruption; remaining17 resumed from that console checkpoint.
browser.visual_spot_checks: Three merged articles’ first figures at desktop and phone widths, plus the consolidated index, inspected. Source artwork unchanged.

public_build.reason: Published urge-surfing references tracking-the-unfolding-experience, which is excluded as a draft in the public build. The same issue is recorded in the pre-existing GoF editorial review. Graphic Design draft-isolation tests pass.

global_graphic_coverage.reason: The existing global registry test reports Missing authored graphic for access-over-ownership. All36 Graphic Design marks were checked separately; no unrelated graphic was changed.

compression.method: Whitespace word count after removing frontmatter, image Markdown including alt/caption syntax, and standalone full-size/stacked-view link lines. Counts active36 pattern bodies plus the contrast foundation; archived originals are excluded from the final reading count. Includes remaining source notes and supporting comparison-link text.

subsequent_reading_compression.scope: Caption, duplicate method-note and production-credit text only; original snapshots and detailed wording retained. Separate from the historical consolidation word counts.
